installCommand: set -euxo pipefail; echo "=== versions ==="; which node || true; node -v; which corepack || true; corepack --version || true; corepack enable; corepack prepare pnpm@8.15.0 --activate; which pnpm; pnpm -v; echo "=== install ==="; pnpm install
buildCommand: npx prisma@^5.10.0 generate --schema=packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma && turbo run build --filter=web
